## About Me

My research focuses on coastal socio-ecological systems, with particular emphasis on mangrove ecosystems, climate change, carbon sequestration and resilience. I am interested in understanding the interactions between ecological processes and human activities in coastal areas, and in developing interdisciplinary approaches that can support climate-change mitigation, adaptation and sustainable coastal management. My current work combines socio-ecological systems thinking, integrated coastal management and DPSIR-based approaches to analyse drivers of environmental change, interactions between people and ecosystems, knowledge and information flows, and opportunities for strengthening resilience. I am particularly interested in linking ecological evidence, local and traditional knowledge, and stakeholder perspectives to inform more context-sensitive and actionable coastal management strategies, especially in the Cuban context.

---

## Research Interests

* Coastal socio-ecological systems and resilience
* Mangrove ecology, carbon sequestration and climate change 
* Socio-ecological interactions and human-environment relationships
* Integrated coastal management
* DPSIR, participatory approaches and knowledge integration
